title: Accelerated fixture-only harvesting

identity.purpose: fast deterministic gather fixture; never a persistent economy worker

acceleration.meaning: 1000% of baseline pacing, exactly 10x; no persistent worker or campaign rate is changed

exact_target_instant_kill.supported_only_when: a server capability probe and fixture adapter both report exact_target_fixture_kill=true

preparation.purpose: Seed one exact worker/source pair and record the inventory and skill baseline.
steps: Allocate one wayfarer/out-of-roster worker with no campaign or persistent gather-lane ownership.
Seed profession, tool, bag space, source identity, and initial materials through the fixture adapter.
Record position seeding as setup only and exclude it from travel or gathering credit.
Capture stable inventory, skills, professioneconomy, snapshot, and gather_route baselines.
Refuse the run if the 10x fixture lease is not capability-attested or the exact source is not in-world.

operation.purpose: Run one native gather attempt at accelerated fixture pacing.
native_evidence_required: native gather or loot credit identifies the exact source and requested material
read-only inventory shows the durable material delta
read-only skill and profession state remain coherent with the worker

postconditions.predicate: 10x pacing is scoped to this fixture and campaign configuration is unchanged
the exact entry and stable spawn are selected and native credit is emitted
the requested material increases and is attributed to the exact source receipt

current_bridge_can_prove: gather_route source and credit when emitted
adapter_still_needed: exact-target instant-kill only for a guarded source that genuinely supports it
durable inventory snapshot if not supplied by the proof harness
adapter_boundary.not_an_adapter_goal: Never replace a missing gather receipt with a synthetic material grant.

cleanup: verify the persistent economy roster and campaign configuration are unchanged
